brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: matter.unsubscribe
objective.description: Remove a matter subscription locally in brique mode or delegate the removal to the owning wrapper in wrapper mode.

#root.role: Resolve one matter identifier and subscription identifier, then remove or delegate the subscription according to the matter ownership mode.

matter_id._comment: Required. Name of the matter to unsubscribe from.

removed._comment: True if the subscription was found and removed.

effects.subscriptions: A local brique-mode subscription may be removed from MatterLoop memory.
effects.wrapper_transport: Wrapper-mode unsubscribe requests are forwarded to the wrapper boundary.

transformation_contract.morphing: A matter identifier plus a subscription identifier becomes an explicit unsubscription acknowledgement, either local in brique mode or delegated to the owning wrapper.
invariants: Unsubscription first resolves the matter through the runtime catalog to decide between local removal and wrapper delegation.
Local brique-mode unsubscription is idempotent at the payload level: removed=false is returned when the sub_id was not present.
Wrapper-mode unsubscribe requests are forwarded unchanged to the owning wrapper boundary.
success: On success, matter.unsubscribe returns ok=true, the matter_id, the sub_id, and the resolved substance_mode.
For local brique-mode unsubscription, removed reports whether a subscription entry was actually deleted.
failure: The capacity fails when matter_id or sub_id is missing.
The capacity refuses unsubscription when the matter is absent from the runtime catalog.
The capacity refuses wrapper-mode unsubscription when the owning wrapper boundary cannot be resolved to a running wrapper.
notes: Only local brique-mode subscriptions are tracked in MatterLoop memory.
Wrapper-mode unsubscription semantics beyond forwarding are owned by the wrapper implementation.
